workflow.sourceOfTruth: This manifest plus Assets/Game/Art/UI/Generated/MatchHUD generated layer sprites.
workflow.flattenedTargetUsage: visual QA reference only; temporary source for minimap and squad portrait content until native content layers are generated.
workflow.requiredValidation: Unity rendered captures at 1672x941 and 20:9, plus focused crop comparison for every named problem object.

rules: Never use the full mockup or large baked panel screenshots as UI.
Frames, fills, content, icons, text, and selected states are separate Unity objects.
Chrome over gameplay must have transparent outside corners.
Overlay frames may have transparent centers; solid cut-corner backplates must keep visible interiors.
Icons and labels are never baked into button or panel backgrounds.
Tab-like command and squad buttons use the shared animated button state controller.
